title.from: Rename repository and transfer to verified Data Parade organization
title.to: Rename and transfer repository to DataParade-io/LeftBlock

description.from: External rename/transfer is explicitly PAUSED pending this project's owner's naming decision after reviewing https://github.com/achrafash/gitbouncer, an existing tool for private-repository share links. Its purpose differs, but the Git/privacy branding overlap is material. Verified target is DataParade-io through existing BotSpy ownership; authenticated account has source admin and destination repository-creation permission. Source access currently includes a team grant that cannot be assumed to survive cross-organization transfer. Preserve access without expanding team or credential permissions. No external rename, transfer or access change has occurred. Codex owns the technical preparation; the project owner must resolve branding before external action resumes.
description.to: Completed and verified: https://github.com/DataParade-io/LeftBlock is the same public repository with unchanged repository ID 1352673840, history and branches; the former AnthusAI/Pudicus URL redirects. Existing access roles were preserved through equivalent repository grants without adding people, teams or credential scope. Repository rename/transfer is technically complete. Canonical package migration, PyPI publishing, logo and rollout remain separate tasks and are not implied complete by this transfer.
